crossRefs.note: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them…
He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.
The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of Yahweh…
They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are…
“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us…

translations.web: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
translations.bsb: to promiscuity, wine, and new wine, which take away understanding.
translations.kjv: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
translations.asv: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the understanding.
